verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop terminal app, but nothing in the evidence addresses telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking, or any setting to disable them. The items on the optional AI plugin and its OpenAI key toggle concern a user-invoked AI feature that sends data to a third party, not telemetry. They do not show a telemetry opt-out, so they are not credited here.
